verses.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.sm: Koru. Esili lava le ALII, e tatau foi ona matua yua o ia i le aai a lo tatou Atua, o lona mauga paia.

verses.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.sm: E matagofie le maualuga o le mauga o Siona, e fiafia ai le lalolagi uma, o i le itu i matu, le aai a le Tupu silisili.

verses.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.sm: E iloa lava le Atua i ona maota, e fai o ia ma ‘olo maualuga.

verses.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, na faapotopoto mai tupu; ua latou o atu faatasi.

verses.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.sm: Nalatou vaavaai mai, ona fememeai ai lea; ua atuatuvale i latou, ona latou vave sosola ese ai lea.

verses.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.sm: Na maua lava i latou i lea mea i le gatete, o le tiza pei o le fafine a fanau mai.

verses.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.sm: Uaedlepetia vaa Tasesa i le matagi mai sasae.

verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.sm: E pei ora tatou faalogo atu ai, e faapea ona tatou iloa ile aai a le ALII o “au, o le aai a lo tatou Atua; e faatamauina ia e le Atua e oo i le faavavau. Sela.

verses.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, ua matou mafaufau i lou alofa i totoau o lou malumalu.

verses.en: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.sm: to Le Atua e, e pei o lou suafa, e faapea lou viiga ona oo i tulu'iga o le lalolagi; ua tumu lou aao taumatau i le amiotonu;

verses.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.sm: ia fiafia le mauga o Siona, ia olioli tamafafine a Iuta, ona c au faamasinoga.

verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.sm: 13 14 11 SALAMO 48, Ina faataamilo ia i Siona, ma ia soo ai, ina faitau ia i ona ‘olo.

verses.en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.sm: Matuá mafaufau ia i lona aupa, ma mátau mai ona maota; ina la outou talatala atu ai i le tupulaga atali; aua O lenei Atua,

verses.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.sm: o lo tatou Atua lava ia e faavavau faavavau lava; o ia lava na te ta'ita'iina i tatou e oo lava i le oti.
